cannot_imply: Analytic statements are solver proof candidates, not independently verified or formally proved.
The supplied exact periodic, one-orbit-per-cell, marks-0/1/2 and mean-mass-one representation is a hypothesis, not a zeta extraction.

Period growth costs are explicit. Small defect alone without Q^2*delta control is not enough for the stated quantitative implication.
Rounded collisions are aggregated; no preservation of the simple count of the rounded model or upper mark bound two is assumed.
The 972-point phase grid is numerical evidence only, not global optimization, interval certification or a proof covering continuous parameters.
